Subject: SCCs & DPA: initial evidence ask

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the call this morning. Legal at SoftMed reviewed the proposed DPA redlines and flagged two implementation gaps we need evidence for before we can move forward with signature:

- Subprocessor inventory with current hosting regions and last-90-day transfers;
- KMS / HSM evidence and whether customer keys are supported in Private deployments;

Can you share a short evidence packet (PDF/CSV) and a redline that aligns SCCs with the order form hosting map? We have an internal review on Friday and would like to close this out this week if possible.

Also: we dropped two narrow SCC edits (liability carveout for transfers) — I pasted them below. If you prefer, Miguel (copied) will take a tracked copy and send back.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Counsel, SoftMed
elena@softmed.com
